changes_data.diff:
@@ -82,4 +82,15 @@ netlogon_dissect_PAC_DEVICE_INFO(tvbuff_t *tvb, int offset,
 			packet_info *pinfo, proto_tree *tree,
 			dcerpc_info *di, uint8_t *drep);
 
+/* needed to dissect PAC_CLAIMS_INFO in kerberos */
+int
+netlogon_dissect_CLAIMS_SET_METADATA_BLOB(tvbuff_t *tvb,
+                                          int offset,
+                                          int length,
+                                          packet_info *pinfo,
+                                          proto_tree *parent_tree,
+                                          int hf_index,
+                                          int ett_index,
+                                          const char *info_str);
+
 #endif /* packet-dcerpc-netlogon.h */

@@ -263,6 +263,11 @@ dissect_doserror(tvbuff_t *tvb, int offset, packet_info *pinfo,
 		 proto_tree *tree, dcerpc_info *di, uint8_t *drep,
 		 int hfindex, uint32_t *pdata);
 
+int
+dissect_werror(tvbuff_t *tvb, int offset, packet_info *pinfo,
+	       proto_tree *tree, dcerpc_info *di, uint8_t *drep,
+	       int hfindex, uint32_t *pdata);
+
 int
 dissect_hresult(tvbuff_t *tvb, int offset, packet_info *pinfo,
 		proto_tree *tree, dcerpc_info *di, uint8_t *drep,

commits_data.title: lz77huff: fix EOF condition
commits_data.message:
lz77huff: fix EOF condition

The value 256 is only special if the end of the input
stream is also reached, otherwise we fail to decompress
valid chunks.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: dcerpc-netlogon: dissect netlogon_dissect_BYTE_array as a BLOB
commits_data.message:
dcerpc-netlogon: dissect netlogon_dissect_BYTE_array as a BLOB

This is much easier to work with than individual bytes.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: dcerpc-netlogon: fix filter string for hf_netlogon_neg_flags_1000000
commits_data.message:
dcerpc-netlogon: fix filter string for hf_netlogon_neg_flags_1000000

This avoids a warning like:

packet-dcerpc-netlogon.c hf_netlogon_neg_flags_100000 : - filter
"ntlmssp.neg_flags.na100000" appears 2 items before - labels are "AES
supported" and "NO NT4 emulation"

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
